evidence: The samples were analyzed by a JEOL-2100F transmission electron microscopy. Atomic force microscopy images of the samples were obtained on a PSIA XE-100 operating in tapping mode. The 1sC/2pSi peak area ratio measured by XPS is about 0.7 and the water contact angle is about 92 /C176, which are close to those of a densely packed 7-octenylsiloxane monolayer prepared in liquid phase. The thickness of the pentacene film was 50 nm as monitored by a quartz crystal oscillator and confirmed by ellipsometry.
